entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: An elf with green fire magic and an unflared spark, pursued by Memnarch for her piece of divinity.

entities.name: Slobad
entities.description: A goblin tinkerer with a strangely heroic spirit who travels with Glissa.

entities.name: Bosh
entities.description: An iron golem searching for his lost memories, who begins turning to flesh from the Mycosynth.

entities.name: Bruenna
entities.description: A Neurok wizard who flies and freezes artifacts, traveling with Glissa.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: The Guardian of Mirrodin, whose mind is breaking down and who seeks Glissa's spark to become a planeswalker.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The creator of Memnarch, who ascended and left Mirrodin, which is coming undone without him.

entities.name: Malil
entities.description: A golem servant made in Memnarch's original image, sent to retrieve Glissa.

entities.name: Pontifex
entities.description: A vedalken who rises to lead the Synod and is driven by obsession to destroy Glissa.

entities.name: Marek
entities.description: A vedalken guard who ultimately saves Glissa and kills Pontifex.

entities.name: Orland
entities.description: A young liberal vedalken who engineers the Vedalken Empire's return to a Republic.

entities.name: Janus
entities.description: A former Synod leader whose death elevated Pontifex.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: Lord of the Vault of Whispers, who holds the last piece of the Kaldra Guardian.

entities.name: Yert
entities.description: Killed by Geth's new reaper in an 'accident'.

entities.name: Drooge
entities.description: The new Troll Leader who gifts Bruenna the helm.

entities.name: Al-Hayat
entities.description: A sapient wolf of the Tangle who joins Glissa's group and dies in the Vault of Whispers.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: His powerstone eyes fused with Karn in the Legacy Weapon.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: An unstable artificial metal plane that is coming undone without Karn.

entities.name: The Darksteel Eye
entities.description: Memnarch's scrying device forged with six scrying mirrors.

entities.name: The Panopticon
entities.description: Memnarch's fortress, built where the green sun will emerge.

entities.name: Mycosynth
entities.description: An infection turning metal to flesh and flesh to metal, fed by the mana core.

entities.name: Kaldra Champion
entities.description: A powerful avatar summoned from sword, helm and shield pieces, wielded through Glissa.

entities.name: Vault of Whispers
entities.description: Geth's lair in the Mephidross, holding the last Kaldra piece.

entities.name: The Tangle
entities.description: A copper forest home to trolls and sapient wolves, devastated by the fifth sun's emergence.

entities.name: Vedalken Empire
entities.description: The vedalken government, governed by the Synod, which becomes a Republic.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: A swampy region of dross on Mirrodin, home of the Vault of Whispers and swarms of nim.

entities.name: Mana core
entities.description: The core of Mirrodin from which suns are ejected.

events.summary: Memnarch straps himself into his serum tank hoping for a vision of Karn, his mind breaking down and his body turning to flesh.
events.quote: Memnarch , Guardian of Mirrodin, straps himself into his serum tank, hoping for a vision of his creator, Karn .

events.summary: Memnarch learns the vedalken are chasing the elf Glissa and sends Malil to retrieve her.
events.quote: He sends Malil, who has been made in Memnarch’s original image, to retrieve her.

events.summary: Cornered by Malil's threshers and levelers, Glissa channels green fire in an explosive burst that disables all pursuers.
events.quote: In a rage at what appears to be the end, Glissa channels her green fire again into an explosive burst that disables all their pursuers.

events.summary: Memnarch rebuffs Pontifex's offer to become part of him, and Pontifex blames Glissa and begins going insane.
events.quote: He interprets this as Glissa being responsible for his god abandoning him, and starts going insane.

events.summary: Bosh barrels through vedalken attackers, and the group learns the Mycosynth is infecting Bosh.
events.quote: To get past, Bosh rolls into a ball and barrels through the attackers.

events.summary: With Janus dead, Pontifex ascends to leadership of the Synod.
events.quote: With Janus dead, Pontifex has ascended to the leadership of the Synod.

events.summary: Drooge, the new Troll Leader, reveals the Kaldra Guardian can be summoned from pieces, the last held in the Vault of Whispers.
events.quote: He reveals they are two pieces necessary to summon a powerful avatar called the the Kaldra Guardian

events.summary: The sapient wolf Al-Hayat joins the group and helps rescue Slobad.
events.quote: He agrees to join the group, and together they rescue Slobad.

events.summary: Pontifex tries to kill Orland and orders Glissa's death, testing Marek's loyalty, until Bruenna arrives with Neurok wizards.
events.quote: Pontifex attempts to kill Orland, and when he orders Glissa’s death, Marek’s loyalty is tested.

events.summary: The nim attack the levelers, letting Glissa's group slip away from Malil.
events.quote: the nim also begin attacking the levelers, much to Malil’s chagrin

events.summary: Memnarch's plan is revealed: he will use the green sun's power and Glissa's spark to become a planeswalker, as Mirrodin comes undone.
events.quote: He has built the Panopticon on the exact spot the green sun will emerge from to use its power and turn himself into a planeswalker .

events.summary: Glissa's group reaches Geth's throne room in the Vault of Whispers, where Geth welcomes them menacingly and springs a trap.
events.quote: Once inside, Geth enters and welcomes them menacingly.

events.summary: Marek captures Glissa, but a standoff between Pontifex and Malil lets her escape and find the Kaldra shield.
events.quote: Glissa is taken captive by Marek, but Malil suddenly arrives with levelers in tow.

events.summary: Glissa emerges in the arm of the Kaldra Champion, slaughtering many vedalken, then destroys every leveler and weapon in rage as Al-Hayat dies.
events.quote: It slaughters many of the Vedalken, and those left beat a hasty retreat.

events.summary: Orland orchestrates a vote returning the Vedalken Empire to a Republic and Pontifex is stripped of power.
events.quote: Pontifex arrives and learns Orland has orchestrated a vote to return the Vedalken Empire to a Republic.

events.summary: Pontifex kills two of his former Synod council members and leaves swearing vengeance.
events.quote: Orland dodges, but the other two are killed.

events.summary: Bruenna and Glissa are devoured by threshers in the core.
events.quote: Bruenna is swallowed whole by one

events.summary: Marek saves Glissa from Pontifex, and Pontifex and Marek kill one another.
events.quote: Pontifex and Marek end up killing one another, leaving Glissa free.

events.summary: Glissa takes out one of Memnarch's legs, but Memnarch casts his trademark spell and seizes control of Kaldra.
events.quote: Memnarch casts his trademark spell and assumes control over the avatar.

events.summary: Bosh steps in front of his friends and is dispatched in seconds.
events.quote: Bosh steps in front of his friends to defend them, but is dispatched in seconds.

events.summary: The fifth sun dawns, evaporating the Kaldra avatar and devastating the Tangle.
events.quote: evaporating the Avatar and devastating the Tangle for miles in every direction

events.summary: Glissa and Slobad survive the blast, as do Memnarch and Malil.
events.quote: Slobad hobbles up to her, scorched and bruised but otherwise intact.

relations.note: seeks her piece of divinity for his plan
relations.quote: He says he needs Glissa before the green sun dawns to incorporate her into his being.

relations.note: ascended to leadership of the Synod
relations.quote: With Janus dead, Pontifex has ascended to the leadership of the Synod.

relations.note: joined her group and healed Slobad
relations.quote: He agrees to join the group, and together they rescue Slobad.

relations.note: assures her the trolls are on her side
relations.quote: He assures her the trolls are on her side

relations.note: close companions who flee Kaldra together
relations.quote: Slobad and Glissa flee, unable to stand against what was supposed to be their trump card
